ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** with a library of a few hundred moments, open Chronicle's Map, then Walks, then Days; open a replay while the map is still loading and come back. **Expect:** each section shows its walks, finds and pins; the view you left is kept on the way back; the three reads (`listChecklistAreas`, `listFinds`, `momentsBetween`), now run together on the one SQLite connection, all answer (fix chronicle-focus-reload).

- **A recall taken while Chronicle's map blurs is lost** (fix chronicle-focus-reload audit 5, older than the fix): a reminder tapped with no walk open; Chronicle's map `load` calls `takeRecallOpen`, which clears `RECALL_OPEN_KEY` before it reads the moments; a replay or day opened (or a tab switched) during that read makes the `if (!live) return null` right after it return, so the moments are never shown and are no longer stored, and `fittedTo` is not recorded either. Take the recall only once nothing can stop the load, or keep it until it is shown (R4, NV13).

argv: Tabs and the recording bar (`/tend tabs`, Nov 11)
ops.body: - [loop] **Chronicle shows two controls for the same choice** (the UX review of fix chronicle-focus-reload, U3, Nov 17, medium, older): the top section row (Memories, Walks, Days, Map, Media) and the sheet's own Walks/Days switch with its Map button change the same views, both on screen at once (pictures `10-home-walks`, `chronicle-t6-bar-walks-framed`). ui-references 1.12 (one segmented control for two to five related views), NN/g H4. Check against the section bar's decisions (0148, SB1-SB4) before changing either.
